# mxstermind

> mxstermind.com is the Founder Operating System for operators who validated revenue and need monetization, ops, growth stack, and economics beyond fixed packages — not a bespoke agency.

## What it is
- Founder Operating System (OS) — monetization rails, ops workflows, growth infrastructure
- Sister platform to BrandForge.gg (fixed USD packages for brand, web, and growth execution)
- Same team network — different layer: execution vs operating system

## Who we serve
- Founders with revenue traction needing systems, not hourly agency retainers
- Operators scaling communities, products, or multi-surface businesses
- Teams that outgrew package tiers and need economics + ops wired together
